title: oMLX
description_en: Mac LLM server that cuts agent wait times from 90s to 5s. oMLX turns your Mac into a full LLM inference server, run from the menu bar. It serves text, vision, OCR, embedding and reranker models with continuous batching, plus a RAM+SSD tiered KV cache that survives restarts, so Claude Code and Cursor respond in about 5s instead of 90s. OpenAI and Anthropic compatible APIs drop straight in. Native Swift, not Electron. Apache 2.0, open source.
description_zh: oMLX将Mac变成完整的LLM推理服务器，通过菜单栏运行。核心创新是RAM+SSD分层KV缓存机制，缓存在重启后仍然保留，配合continuous batching技术，使Claude Code和Cursor的响应时间从传统90秒降至约5秒。支持文本、视觉、OCR、embedding和reranker模型，提供OpenAI和Anthropic兼容API，可无缝替换云端服务。采用Native Swift开发而非Electron，性能优化极致。目标用户是需要本地运行LLM的开发者，特别是使用AI编程工具的Mac用户。Apache 2.0开源协议，Product Hunt获83票，GitHub话题标签显示开发者工具定位。

title: Maritime
description_en: Dedicated computers for AI agents, starting at $1/month. Maritime helps companies that sell AI agents give every customer an agent with its own computer. Each agent runs in an isolated, persistent VM where it can use a browser, create files, run code, and keep its state. Maritime handles the infrastructure, scaling, and automatic sleep/wake, so you don’t have to build and manage thousands of VMs yourself. Built for companies running agents at scale, starting at $1 per agent per month.
description_zh: Maritime解决AI Agent规模化部署的基础设施问题。当企业向客户销售AI Agent时，每个Agent需要独立的计算环境来运行浏览器、执行代码、创建文件并保持状态。Maritime提供隔离的、持久化的VM环境，每个Agent拥有独立计算机。产品自动处理基础设施扩展、VM的休眠/唤醒机制，企业无需自建和管理成千上万个VM。定价从每Agent每月$1起，专为需要大规模运行Agent的企业设计。产品刚在Product Hunt发布，获得78票，属于开发者工具类别，目前处于早期阶段。

title: Einfall
description_en: Capture fugitive thoughts + route them to where they belong. Einfall catches the fugitive thought — the one that falls into your head at the strangest times — before it's gone. Capture quick and easy on Mac, iPhone and iPad, from the menu bar, share sheet, Shortcuts, widgets, Spotlight and Siri. Process the thoughts by sending them to Reminders, Calendar, Files, a Shortcut, or by giving your AI agent control via MCP. Capture is free and unlimited. full_profile.insight_zh: Creekstone视角：Token优化是真实痛点但市场规模存疑。随着模型价格持续下降（GPT-4从$0.03降到$0.01/1K tokens），企业对token优化的付费意愿可能减弱。更大的机会在于：①将token优化整合进更大的LLM Ops平台（被收购路径）；②专注服务超大规模LLM用户（如客服系统、内容生成平台）建立深度集成。风险：①工具类产品容易被LangChain等大平台集成为免费功能；②OpenAI等模型提供商可能直接在API层提供优化建议；③市场教育成本高，开发者可能不愿为省几美元付费订阅。Alpha机会较小，更像是执行层面的效率工具而非结构性机会。
full_profile.score_narrative_zh: AI Native得12分：产品本身是为LLM设计的工具，但不是AI-native产品，更像传统linter加了LLM场景适配，无自进化能力，无数据飞轮。Niche得14分：token优化是真实但小众需求，有一定技术门槛（需理解tokenization机制），但壁垒不高，容易被大平台复制。商业模式得6分：纯开源无变现计划，未来路径不明确，即使做SaaS也面临激烈竞争和用户付费意愿问题。团队得9分：仅知作者ritenv，无背景信息，无法判断AI+domain能力，信息严重不足。加分14分：开源项目+2，解决真实开发者痛点+3，可能被LLM Ops平台收购+3，timing合适（LLM成本优化需求上升）+3，工具类产品易集成+3。减分-3：信息严重不足难以全面评判。

description_en: Claude Code for the rest of us. Working with a coding agent should feel like using a good Mac app, not a terminal. title: Mugiwara Security
description_en: Proves vulnerabilities before reporting them.. Most scanners flag anything suspicious and leave you to sort out what's real. Mugiwara proves it instead. It generates a proof-of-concept exploit, runs it in an isolated container, and only marks a finding verified if the attack actually works. For verified issues, an AI patches a disposable copy and we re-run the same exploit to confirm it's blocked. Everything runs locally-your code never leaves your machine. V0: injection classes in Python. Feedback welcome, especially on false positives.
